evidence.detail: integer constants FNM=1, SAT=2, APAC=3, SUN=4, MON=5, THU=6 — new series needs a new constant here
get_all_next_tournament_dates builds rrule tuples per series — new series needs a new rrule line and a return-list entry here
all_series_info() returns a list of Container dicts with hosts, display_time, sponsor, etc. — new series needs a third separate entry here
Adding a tournament series currently requires touching three disjoint places: constants, get_all_next_tournament_dates, and all_series_info, matching the issue description

triage.fix_sketch: Define a single SERIES_DATA list of dicts/dataclasses in magic/tournaments.py that contains all per-series fields (weekday, hour, minute, timezone, series_name, hosts, display_time, sponsor_name, ID). Derive both get_all_next_tournament_dates and all_series_info from iteration over SERIES_DATA, eliminating the three-point editing requirement. Affects magic/tournaments.py wholesale (~300 lines of restructuring) with moderate risk to tournament scheduling; thorough testing via magic/tournaments_test.py is needed.
triage.notes: The comment on the issue mentions making this data-not-code (e.g. a config file or DB table), which would be an even larger scope change. The minimum viable improvement is the single-source-of-truth refactor within the Python file.
